meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论同步为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论
copy.tagline_en: Sync GitHub PR and issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat

howto.what: 当用户在GitHub的PR或Issue评论中@机器人时，Claude会回复该评论；首次@后，机器人会自动关注该线程，后续所有评论都会自动回复。
howto.when: 当用户在GitHub仓库的PR或Issue评论中@指定的机器人用户名时触发。

say.text: 在PR评论中@my-bot，让它检查代码风格。
say.note: 机器人会回复检查结果。

say.text: 在Issue中@my-bot，让它回答技术问题。
对已有对话的线程评论，机器人会自动回复。

howto.what_en: When the bot is mentioned in a GitHub PR or issue comment, Claude replies. After the first mention, the thread is subscribed and subsequent comments are answered automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the bot's username is mentioned in a PR or issue comment on a monitored GitHub repository.

say_en.text: Mention @my-bot in a PR comment to request a code review.
say_en.note: The bot will reply with its review.

say_en.text: Mention @my-bot in an issue comment to ask for technical help.
say_en.note: The bot will provide an answer.

say_en.text: Comment on an active thread to continue the conversation.
say_en.note: The bot will auto-reply after first mention.
